entries.en: Dey really is on de other side.
Rosine saw them. It's not a rumor.
entries.ro: Rosine i-a văzut. Nu e doar un zvon.

entries.en: Maybe it... it's a trick! All part of Placide plan!
entries.ro: Poate e o șmecherie! E tot planul lui Placide!

entries.en: And you said it couldn't be done.
entries.ro: Și tu ziceai că nu se poate.

entries.en: You meaning who? Paulette had doubts, not me.
entries.ro: Pe cine zici tu? Paulette avea dubii, nu eu.

entries.en: I knew it would work from de very beginning.
entries.ro: Știam de la început că o să meargă.

entries.en: Placide found work for her to do.
Suzette?! I guess he taking anyone he can get now.
entries.ro: Suzette?! Cred că ia acum pe oricine prinde.
